item.title: Day-to-day activities limited (Census 2021, by Settlement)
item.subtitle: data-population
item.description: Day-to-day activities limited (Settlement) from the 2021 NI Census, recorded by NISRA. Each polygon is shaded by the percentage on a viridis colour ramp; the table panel that opens at the bottom right shows the underlying count and population denominator.

references.label: NISRA Census 2021, Main Statistics Phase 1, MS-D02 (Long-term health problem or disability)
